definitions.explanation: The week before this one; the previous week. Used to refer to events or states in the week that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I watched a movie last week.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}に{友達|ともだち}と{会|あ}いました。
examples.english: I met with a friend last Friday.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}は{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}かったです。
examples.english: There was a lot of rain last week.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}{買|か}った{本|ほん}をまだ{読|よ}んでいません。{時間|じかん}がありません。
examples.english: I haven't read the book I bought last week yet. I don't have time.

examples.japanese: {先週|せんしゅう}{友達|ともだち}と{食|た}べた{店|みせ}はとても{美味|おい}しかったです。また{行|い}きたいです。
examples.english: The restaurant where I ate with my friend last week was very delicious. I want to go again.

notes:
{先週|せんしゅう} means 'last week' and is part of the time reference system.

TIME SERIES - WEEKS:
- {先々週|せんせんしゅう}: the week before last
- {先週|せんしゅう}: last week
- {今週|こんしゅう}: this week
- {来週|らいしゅう}: next week
- {再来週|さらいしゅう}: the week after next

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {先|せん}: previous, before
- {週|しゅう}: week

SIMILAR WORDS WITH {先|せん}:
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {先日|せんじつ}: the other day
- {先年|せんねん}: years ago

GRAMMAR NOTES:
- Used as time adverb without particle: {先週|せんしゅう}{会|あ}った (I met [them] last week)
- With specific day: {先週|せんしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび} (last Monday)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先週|せんしゅう}の{末|まつ}: end of last week
- {先週|せんしゅう}から: since last week
